Package com.vectorpeaks.backend.controller

Class ChatController

java.lang.Object
com.vectorpeaks.backend.controller.ChatController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/chats") @PreAuthorize("isAuthenticated()") @CrossOrigin(origins="*") public class ChatController extends Object
REST controller handling chat-related HTTP requests in the EduLink system.

Exposes the following endpoints:

  • POST /api/chats – create or retrieve an existing chat thread
  • GET /api/chats/user/{userId} – list all chats for a user
  • GET /api/chats/{chatId}/messages – fetch message history
  • POST /api/chats/{chatId}/messages – send a new message
*

Includes built-in BOLA (Broken Object Level Authorization) protection and security event logging.

Version:
1.2
Author:
EduLink Team

  • Method Details

    • createOrGetChat

      @PostMapping public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> createOrGetChat(@RequestBody ChatDtos.CreateChatRequest request, org.springframework.security.core.Authentication authentication)
      Creates a new chat between two users or returns the existing one. Validates if the authenticated user is one of the participants.
      Parameters:
      request - request body containing the IDs of both participants
      authentication - the security context containing the logged-in user's details
      Returns:
      200 OK with the ChatDtos.ChatResponse, or 403 Forbidden / 400 Bad Request

    • getUserChats

      @GetMapping("/user/{userId}") @PreAuthorize("#userId == authentication.principal or hasRole(\'ADMIN\')") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<List<ChatDtos.ChatResponse>> getUserChats(@PathVariable Integer userId)
      Returns all chat threads (conversations) for the given user. Handled by method-level security to ensure users only access their own chats.
      Parameters:
      userId - the ID of the user whose chats are to be retrieved
      Returns:
      200 OK with a list of ChatDtos.ChatResponse objects

    • getMessages

      @GetMapping("/{chatId}/messages") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> getMessages(@PathVariable Integer chatId, org.springframework.security.core.Authentication authentication)
      Returns the full message history of the given chat thread. The service layer verifies if the user is an active participant in this chat.
      Parameters:
      chatId - the ID of the chat thread
      authentication - the security context containing the logged-in user's details
      Returns:
      200 OK with message list, 403 if access denied, or 404 if chat not found

    • sendMessage

      @PostMapping("/{chatId}/messages") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> sendMessage(@PathVariable Integer chatId, @RequestBody ChatDtos.SendMessageRequest request, org.springframework.security.core.Authentication authentication)
      Persists a new message sent by a user in the specified chat thread. Verifies sender identity and participant status before saving.
      Parameters:
      chatId - the ID of the target chat thread
      request - request body containing the sender's ID and message content
      authentication - the security context containing the logged-in user's details
      Returns:
      201 Created with the saved message, or error status

    • markChatAsRead

      @PostMapping("/{chatId}/read") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> markChatAsRead(@PathVariable Integer chatId, org.springframework.security.core.Authentication authentication)
